thread:
anika: heads up — after q4f quantization of sable-v1 we’re seeing a repro-able drop on zh->ja translation BLEU and some weird detok/token boundary mismatches when latin punctuation is involved. sample below.

jeff: can you paste the minimal prompt + before/after outputs?

anika: minimal repro: INPUT: "把最新的API文档推送到ci分支，然后发个通知。"

- float32 (master):
  "最新のAPIドキュメントをCIブランチにプッシュして、通知を送ってください。"

- q4f (quantized):
  "最新のAPIドキュメントをCIブランチにプッシュして. 通知送ってください。"

notes: notice the stray full stop and the space before "通知" — tokenization/spacing shifted. Also macro BLEU drop on our zh-ja suite: 12 -> 8.7.

sophia: who ran the quant config? which kernel/pack? any changes to tokenization or vocab?

anika: quant run: q4f-perf-profile-2026-03-18, kernel: cuda-opt-v5, vocab unchanged (same tokenizer json). no tokenizer package bumps in the deploy. eval harness id: locale_regression_harness:zh_ja_v2 test=12.

kai: odd. could be KV-cache alignment + token id remap after quant pack reshuffle. do we have logits/topk traces for the step? even a short diff of token ids would help.

anika: attached small trace (trimmed):
```
step 1 tokens (float32): [101, 2034, 9873, 12, 4002]
step 1 tokens (q4f):     [101, 2034, 9873, 5, 4002]
```

anika: the punctuation token index changed (12 -> 5) which explains spacing. but tokenizer json maps look identical; suspect runtime token-id remap at load-time due to quant packing order.

jeff: if true that’s scary — tokenizer should be deterministic. can we repro by forcing load with explicit token_map in the serve config? try set SERVE_TOKEN_MAP="none" or pin vocab sha.

anika: tried pinning vocab sha, still reproduces. I think it's happening during compiled kernel serialization step (pack reindex).

taka: I can run a bisect across the runtime kernels tomorrow. quick checklist: 1) reproduce with minimal docker image (no cache) 2) dump token id mapping right after model load 3) compare saved artifacts between float and quant builds. assigning to me. @jeff can you queue a canary with verbose token-load logs?

jeff: queued. deploy-bot: canary requested by jeff for project/sable-v1 quant-canary-171800.

deploy-bot: canary started — logs at https://ci.internal/redwood/canaries/171800/sable-v1-q4f (auto updates).

sophia: parallel thought — our eval harness detok postprocess may be sensitive to punctuation token IDs if we rely on id-based heuristics. worth running eval as raw token-id diff to separate tokenization issues from generation semantics.

kai: good point. if token ids differ then BLEU drop is likely a detok artifact, not a generation regression. but we still need to prevent token-id remap at runtime.

anika: adding a few failing examples to the repro gist and the locale suite. gist: https://internal.gists/sable-q4f-detok-sample (links internal).

taka: plan: (1) reproduce in minimal container (2) dump model load token-id map + kernel pack metadata (3) run kernel-variant bisect (cuda-opt-v4/v5/qkernel/fallback) (4) run raw-token diff eval on whole zh->ja suite. will update by EOD tomorrow.

jeff: thanks. priority high — this could affect other CJK pairs. also flag to infra: do not roll quant pack to prod until we confirm.

anika: noted. tagging folks in our incident tracker.

sophia: one more: run a quick char-level alignment check for mixed CJK+latin sentences. I can run that on the suite now and share heatmap.

anika: awesome — appreciate it.

kai: if anyone else spots similar Sable or other models (lynx/sora), drop a note here.

jeff: will follow up once canary logs are in. :mag_right:
